Metadata.Title: Dark Souls III
Metadata.Name: Lower Audio Latency
Metadata.Note: The sound engine (FromSoftware's MagicOrchestra over FMOD) updates 60 times a second instead of 30, so a sound the game starts plays up to 17 ms sooner. Its setup text in the executable says MainThreadUpdateTime= 33333 (microseconds); this makes it 16666, found by the text itself whatever five digits it has, so every version of the game that has the line gets it. Bloodborne's 60 FPS++ patch sets the same value.
